s6.text: God hath made me to laugh, so that all that hear will laugh with me.

s7.text: Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born him a son in his old age.

s10.text: Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, even with Isaac.

h16.text: Let me not see the death of the child.

a22.text: God is with thee in all that thou doest:

a23a.text: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son:

a23b.text: but according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.

a26.text: I wot not who hath done this thing: neither didst thou tell me, neither yet heard I of it, but to day.

a29.text: What mean these seven ewe lambs which thou hast set by themselves?

b30.text: For these seven ewe lambs shalt thou take of my hand, that they may be a witness unto me, that I have digged this well.
